    # ======================================================================

    # Purpose:
    #   Reproduce a plate-based sample/reagent assay independently so that
    #   reported FIGURES (per-sample signals), CLAIMS (reproducibility across
    #   triplicates; blanks near background) and LIMITATIONS (single-plate

    #   - Reagent     : 20 uL per destination well from reagent_trough A1
    #   - Sample      : 10 uL per replicate (30 uL final in replicate wells)
    #
    # Constraints respected:
    #   - 50 uL tips          -> every aspirate kept <= 20 uL
    #   - 96 tips available   -> 64 tips used (32 reagent + 24 sample + 8 blank)
    # ======================================================================

    # ---- 1. Acquire pre-configured deck resources ----
    tip_rack = lh.get_resource("tip_rack_50ul")
    source_plate = lh.get_resource("source_plate")
    dest_plate = lh.get_resource("destination_plate")
    trough = lh.get_resource("reagent_trough")

    rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F", "G", "H"]
    rep_columns = [2, 3, 4]        # triplicate columns on destination plate
    blank_column = 5               # reagent-only negative controls
    REAGENT_VOL = 20.0             # uL reagent per destination well
    SAMPLE_VOL = 10.0              # uL sample per replicate
    MIX_VOL = 15.0                 # uL mixing stroke (below tip capacity)
    MIX_CYCLES = 3

    # NOTE: ensure channel A1 of the trough holds >= 1.5 mL reagent
    # (32 wells x 20 uL delivery + 32 x 20 uL pre-wet = ~1.3 mL, plus dead volume).

    # ---- 2. Sequential tip management (column-major through the rack) ----
    tip_positions = [f"{r}{c}" for c in range(1, 13) for r in rows]
    tips_used = 0

    async def take_tip():
        """Pick the next free tip; fail loudly if the rack is exhausted."""
        nonlocal tips_used
        if tips_used >= len(tip_positions):
            raise RuntimeError(
                "Tip rack exhausted: replication protocol requires 64 tips."
            )
        tip_well = tip_rack[tip_positions[tips_used]]
        tips_used += 1
        await lh.pick_up_tips(tip_well)

    # then deliver reagent to its target well.

    ]
